reviews.title: Bye, bye
reviews.text: Upgraded to Plus — no Plus features are present. Asked for refund—it was not processed. The design is very confusing—no intuitive way to move between screens and functions. For instance, there is no obvious way to exit the settings or calendar screens. It is just after 10 minutes of using it. Bye bye.

reviews.title: Blocklists are behind subscriptions
reviews.text: And no one time purchase option at all. Lacking even the most basic behavior but failing to offer anything other apps don’t have for free or one time purchase? No need for it to exist.

reviews.title: No Pause
reviews.text: I am sure on the trial version there was a pause button next to the end button in the Dynamic Island - when I paid for the app it disappeared. Am I mistaken ?

reviews.title: Key features behind subscription paywall
reviews.text: Whilst this app is nice looking, ultimately I’m not going to pay for a timer. Key features like adjusting the duration of the break are behind a paywall, which I find ridiculous, especially considering this app uses a subscription, not a one-time payment. If key features like these need to be paid for, what is the point of having this app…. It is really just a bit of a gimmick, with the cute illustrations of tomatoes, and then a productivity tool. I downloaded this and have very swiftly chosen to delete it because ultimately this is an app that you need to pay a subscription to properly use and frankly that would be a waste of my money when there are other free options online.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: This was a nice, simple pomodoro app. Beautiful, whimsical design, and it stayed out of your way. The last two days I have been interrupted as I try to start a work session with a hard-to-dismiss prompt to pay for some extra service with almost no information about what the money was for. I almost went and paid the money, but I realised all I really wanted was to be rid of the prompt to pay!! Get rid of the prompts, and keep this simple app simple.

reviews.title: Limited time off add won’t stop showing up
reviews.text: I had this app for a while but had to delete it due to storage problems with my older phone now that I got a newer one I been and with more storage I decided to get back into the app. Once I opened it and noticed that an add for limited offer plan with -72% discount has been showing up every time I opened the app to focus and lately has been disrupting the use of the app as I have to restart the app every time I want to go on use the app but due to it showing up every single time I open it and there’s no way to get rid of it other than restarting it has become harder to get things started on and keep track of what I have done. Today I have only been able to focus on one single thing due to how often the ad has shown up. This is really disappointing and difficult decision to delete the app or wait till the 26 hours have passed until I am able to use it.

Same thing happens to blacklisted apps, only a handful actually get blacklisted... I don't have enough self control to not have these apps blocked 😫

reviews.title: Gotten worse - now totally unuseable
reviews.text: This used to be a fab app, now you can’t even use it. The pop ups no longer have x’s on them so you can’t even get into the app anymore. Remove them or at least allow them to be clicked off.

reviews.title: Not timer label
reviews.text: Shows just a clock no timer label on every device except watch. So an otherwise great app is useless. Can just use Clock for that, for free.

reviews.title: Too many features that require pro
reviews.text: You can’t add more than a few tasks to track before needing to pay for pro and overall there are better free apps out there

reviews.title: Study
reviews.text: I cannot understand why there isn’t a repeat button. If i have a schedule for a week then i want it the same for each week but i have to type them out individually and there is no repeat button to help!!
